questions.question: In Joel's prophecy, when God restores Judah and Jerusalem, what does He say He will do with all the nations?

answers.text: Bring them down to one valley
Send them all home in peace

questions.question: In Joel's prophecy, God judges the nations in the Valley of Jehoshaphat. What is He judging them for?

answers.text: How they treated His people Israel
How they treated their own kings
How they ran their trade routes

questions.question: In Joel's prophecy, what are the nations told to do with their farm tools as God gathers them?
In Joel's prophecy, while heaven and earth tremble, what will the LORD be for His people?

answers.text: A judge watching from far away
A voice they can no longer hear
